lines: The National Anthem - Indonesia Raya Please keep your spirit up ladies and gentlemen.. ..although the weather is cloudy, please stay.. Friends, today's action is a form of the Indonesian people's mental revolution. Our constitution must be placed above the Trisakti. ..speaking on economic growth, why question the richness of our high ranking officials..

..let's teach them what the Trisakti is.. ..well, friends, i'm going to stop my speech now.. ..we live near a railway track.. Who wants to talk about that ? She does.. Have you got it ? / not yet..umm..get what ? the cash not yet How much money will you get ? I don't know. How much money will you receive ? I don't know.

approximately..? how much do you reckon ? ..i don't know yet.. ..a rough estimate..? ..30 thousands rups (US$ 2,5).. How many friends do you think join this action ? ..about 20.. How did you get here ? / Riding a Metro Mini bus What is your demand ? ..to support Jokowi to become the police chief.. that's all why do you support Jokowi to become the police chief ?

I know nothing.. i don't watch tv news ..I was just grabbed to join this event.. Who grabbed you ? ..the organizer.. why did you say yes ? / because they will give me money.. you will receive the money for.. ? ..for my payment to do this action. How much money ? 30 thousands rups (US$2,5) Do you understand the issue ?

No What I understand is that we're getting evicted all the time.. What is the name of the organizer ? Ms. Eli.. Elisabeth.. Which one ? There she is.. Are you Ms. Eli ? This is our boss.. What about you ? No. I brought in the SPGs here.. They want to know the issue. Hey.. hey miss..come here..

..don't run away.. ..come here.. hey miss..it's ok.. ..no.. i'm embarrassed.. ..what should i say on camera..? anything / no please miss / no..you're better to do it than me. Hey SPG.. please say on camera that you support BG.. ..wait for a sec..I'm being interviewed.. Hey you in there..

..just gather here.. You've asked me to accompany, is there a fee for it ? yes there is...a free drink.. She wants a fee.. not a free drink.. ..uuh she wants a fee.. ..well..I support everyone who is right or wrong.. We are here to support BG to become the police chief.. ..we don't get paid.. it's a voluntary participation..

Appoint BG as national police chief ! let's do it again.. Appoint BG as national police chief ! If not, what will you do ? He must be appointed. But the President's Team of Nine has announced that he will not be appointed. What will you do then ? He must be appointed first.. the other matter can be solved later..it's easy..

Long live BG ! BG must be appointed ! Long live BG. BG must be appointed ! Long Live Mr. Jokowi ! Long live police chief / long live BG ! Long live Jokowi ! Long live Jokowi yes ! ..please miss, you can speak up.. We support BG. Yeah, while we are in this condition, we support BG. ..even though wearing the broken sandals..

..don't film on the legs.. ..please continue.. ..even though with broken sandals, but you support BG.. ..yes..Maam..please speak..anything.. What should I say ? For the sake of Indonesia ..we.. For the sake of Indonesia, we're here under the rain... ..and in hunger.. to support BG Gunawan.. ..constitution.. from.. Mr. President..

What is your story in joining this event Maam ? It's on my own will.. Any organizers asked you to join ? No..I just join in.. And..do you have plan to do this kind of action again ? Yes, if needed for another one, we will do it again What do you mean ? ..we do this to fix the problems..

How's the way to ask you to join for an action ? ..we will come if asked to do an action for a goodness.. The payment is for just the minibus, or you also want a fee ? ..umm payment for just the bus or for the fee as well.. ..well, we are poor people, we want the payment.. ..for our daily needs.. How much is the fee ?

..whatever amount is fine, as long as for the goodness.. You're ok with 20 thousands rups (US$ 1,7) ? That's to low.. 25 thousands rups (US$ 2) ? ..still too low.. but it's ok for the goodness of Indonesia So, you are ok with 25 thousands ? ..that's too low.. I'm ok with 50 thousands (US$ 4) ..if possible..more than that.. ..we are poor people..to support the goodness..

..life is getting tough..especially in the rainy season.. We know that the government has a lot of money.. ..why not share them to us, when we're asked to do this kind of action.. for the goodness.. ..have mercy on us..
